title: Mega celebrate A League title
description: Kavkasia - Mega 86-96 Mega clinched A League title. They beat Kavkasia on the road today to complete the sweep of the championship series. Mega looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists comparing to just 10 passes made by Kavkasia's players. The best player for the winners was American guard Aston Francis (185-97, college: Wheaton, IL) who scored 23 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. Point guard Irakli Mikeladze (180-94) chipped in 27 points and 4 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was American point guard Elliott Cole (180-94, college: Charleston) who recorded 27 points and 4 assists and guard Giorgi Rukhadze (183-0) added 15 points and 8 rebounds respectively. Four Kavkasia players scored in double figures.
